summary: Blue Owl Credit Income Corp. filed an 8-K reporting a routine unregistered private placement of 191,466 Class I common shares for $1.75 million, priced from a $9.14 August 31, 2026 NAV per Class I share, sold to feeder vehicles exempt under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation S, with no registered exchange listing. The filing also disclosed monthly distributions of $0.070100 gross per Class S, D and I share declared August 4, 2026, and updated continuous offering status: roughly $22.46 billion raised across 2.39 billion shares under the offering and private placement. No special-situation transaction, board recommendation, advisor, premium, close date or deal terms apply; the risk-arb angle is nil, as this is ordinary BDC capital formation and distribution disclosure.
